fixed: Original DirectSuccessorMLP, action embedding 8, GELU, AdamW defaults, weight_decay=1e-4, repeated-step successor CE; original initialization seed per seed-map; CPU 1 thread, deterministic algorithms
training: 720 independent from-scratch fits; A and B each instantiate a fresh model and optimizer; no resampling; no early stop or model selection; training loss logging only during fits
evaluation_boundary: All 720 fits complete and weights/predictions frozen before any observed accuracy, heldout, unseen, behavioral or CTL/LTL evaluation
adequacy_diagnostic: 100% observed unique and repeated-step accuracy, CE<=0.05; descriptive only, never extend training
analysis_splits: all360; pilot9; remaining351; conservative excluded entire pilot seed-map pools345; excluded all pilot base-layouts180
statistics: Within seed-map-budget paired differences, macro and pooled with denominators; wins/ties/losses descriptive only; budget/seed/family/base-layout summaries; six family-layout blocks average all rotations/seeds/budgets, leave-one-family and leave-one-seed sensitivity. No iid edge/case p-values or naive CIs. Fixed designed maps and 3 seeds do not support population inference.
primary: Observed unique and repeated-step accuracy, unseen moving, unseen self-loop, all unseen, reachable/unreachable unseen moving
secondary: Saved 64 heldout traces per seed-map, unchanged two action semantics simulation/bisimulation and identity bisimulation, six CTL and six universal-path LTL formulas
cost: Record loop wall/process CPU seconds, updates, repeated steps, unique pairs, exposures and params; historical original MLP/JEPA time separate from local new runs. B is an approximate pilot-informed budget, not equal FLOPs or guaranteed equal local time.
no_changes: No JEPA modification, source/history overwrite, paper edits, Git merge or push; no Experiment02 mechanism analysis
